The '''Training simulator''' was a device used to train various [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] in flying ships via simulations, thus ensuring there's minimal risk of actually being killed during training.

The devices were shaped in a similar manner to [[Darth Vader's meditation chamber/Legends|Darth Vader's meditation chamber]], and allowed the pilot to fly with controls adjusted to resemble that of various Imperial fighter craft.

The pilot, when using it, ends up flying through a holographic obstacle course, where they have to destroy as many targets as possible as well as complete one lap within the allotted time. Those that managed to complete at least 5 successful laps were eligible to get a [[training patch]] of the fighter they utilized for the simulator.

==Behind the scenes==
The '''Training Simulator''' was a mode in the game [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]. It acted as the game's equivalent of the [[pilot proving grounds]] from [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] and ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''.
